row.boundary_en: A deployment-demand signal, not quantization-effect evidence or Ascend support/gain.
row.boundary_zh: 这是部署需求信号，不是量化效果证据；尚不能据此给出昇腾适配或收益。
row.fact_en: The official announcement reports 1T total and 52B active parameters, with API preview now and weights planned for month-end.
row.fact_zh: 官方公告披露1万亿总参数、520亿激活参数；当前为API预览，权重计划月底发布。
row.locator: Official announcement: opening preview; Frontier performance; model card (MoE); analyst raw-weight estimate = total parameters × bits / 8
row.relevance_en: 52B active parameters describe per-token participation, not all resident weights. With the announced 1T total, an all-16-bit or all-4-bit representation would have about 2TB or 0.5TB of raw weights (decimal theoretical estimates, excluding scales, KV and replicas; not deployment measurements). Quantization can reduce expert storage and loading bytes, but not eliminate routing or cross-device traffic. Once weights are available, compare expert calibration coverage, precision fallback for sensitive experts and actual residency/loading costs before choosing W4 over W8. The announcement supplies no quantization method or result.
row.relevance_zh: 52B激活参数描述每token参与计算的规模，不能按52B估算全部权重驻留。按公告的1T总参数，全部权重以16-bit／4-bit保存的裸数据量分别约2TB／0.5TB（十进制理论估算，不含尺度、KV和副本，非实际部署值）。权重量化可减小专家存储与装载字节，但不能消除路由和跨卡搬运；权重开放后，应比较各专家校准覆盖、敏感专家精度回退与实际驻留／装载成本，再判断W4是否优于W8。公告尚未提供量化方案或效果。
row.title_en: Mistral Large 4: trillion-parameter MoE residency motivates evaluating expert-weight quantization
row.title_zh: Mistral Large 4：万亿MoE的权重驻留压力，需评估专家权重量化

row.boundary_en: Results span September and October; this signal uses October 1 build B. FPGA outcomes do not transfer to Ascend.
row.boundary_zh: 表格含9月及10月实验；此处以10月1日build B记录为本期线索，FPGA结果不可外推至昇腾。
row.fact_en: The project separates device and wall speeds on a Kintex-7 PCIe card. Two-level scales yield 4.25 bits/weight with an int8 head. October 1 build B reports Qwen3.5-2B INT8/4-bit wall decode at 8.00/12.03 tok/s with a 512-token prompt and 64 greedy tokens.
row.fact_zh: 项目在Kintex-7 PCIe板卡上分别报告device/wall速度；4-bit含两级尺度实际为4.25 bit/weight，LM head保留INT8。10月1日build B的Qwen3.5-2B，INT8/4-bit wall解码为8.00/12.03 tok/s，使用512-token prompt、64 greedy tokens。
row.locator: README Results, measurement dates, method and 4-bit encoding paragraphs
row.relevance_en: This exemplifies joint weight-format and execution design, not automatic acceleration from a smaller file. In the same Qwen3.5-2B setup, wall decode rises from 8.00 to 12.03 tok/s, about 1.50× (calculated from the table). Scales bring 4-bit weights to 4.25 bits/weight, with an INT8 LM head. An Ascend W4/W8 comparison should account for scales, high-precision layers and packing, alongside bytes per token, dequantization time, end-to-end latency and task quality. If fewer bits do not reduce actual traffic or wall time, investigate decoding, transfers and host bottlenecks before lowering precision further.
row.relevance_zh: 这是权重量化与执行路径协同的实例，不是把文件缩小就自动提速。同一Qwen3.5-2B设置的wall解码从8.00到12.03 tok/s，约1.50倍（由原表计算）；4-bit权重含尺度实际为4.25 bit/weight，且LM head仍为INT8。昇腾比较W4/W8时，应把尺度、保留高精度层和打包计入总字节，同时记录每token访存、反量化耗时、端到端时延与同任务质量。若位宽降低但实际字节或wall耗时未降，应先查解码、搬运和主机瓶颈，而非继续追低位宽。
row.title_en: openTPU: 4-bit block quantization reduces weight traffic; scales and host costs constrain gains
row.title_zh: openTPU：以4-bit块量化减少权重搬运，收益须计入尺度与主机开销

row.boundary_en: Adjacent architecture tradeoff, not proof of pruning/distillation; generation quality is incomparable and Ascend is unmeasured.
row.boundary_zh: 这是相邻的架构取舍，不是剪枝或蒸馏实现证明；通用生成质量不可类比，未有昇腾实测。
row.fact_en: The official post replaces the Qwen3.5-2B LM head with a pointer head and rank-16 LoRA tuning; the model selects options rather than generating general text.
row.fact_zh: 官方介绍用Qwen3.5-2B主干替换LM head为pointer head，并用rank-16 LoRA微调；模型面向选项决策，不能生成通用文本。
row.locator: Official post date; Model Architecture; limitations paragraph
row.relevance_en: This is task specialization, removing unnecessary text generation for fixed-option decisions, not SparseGPT/Wanda-style pruning. For Ascend classification, tool selection or routing, first compare decision accuracy, confidence calibration and end-to-end latency on the same label set; only then assess further weight quantization. Do not directly replace open-ended answering, summarization or multi-step reasoning. Its Weight × Pruning association is context for deciding what model functionality a task needs, not implementation evidence for that algorithm family.
row.relevance_zh: 它走的是任务专用化路线，解决固定选项决策中通用文本生成的多余工作，不是SparseGPT／Wanda式剪枝。对昇腾上的分类、工具选择或路由业务，先以同一标签集比较决策准确率、置信度校准和端到端时延；达标后再评估是否还需要权重量化。开放式问答、摘要和多步推理不宜直接替换。技术地图中的“权重×剪枝”仅把它作为删减模型功能之前的方案取舍背景，不能计入该算法路线的实现证据。
row.title_en: Strands Decider 2B: a pointer head scores options in one pass instead of generating a decision
row.title_zh: Strands Decider 2B：用pointer head一次选项打分，减少决策任务的生成开销
